def count_valid_colorings(n: int, m: int) -> int:
    """Count proper colorings of a labeled cycle modulo 998244353.

    The cycle chromatic polynomial is (m - 1)**n + (-1)**n * (m - 1).
    Time: O(log n). Auxiliary space: O(1).
    """
    mod = 998244353
    q = m - 1
    correction = q if n % 2 == 0 else -q
    return (pow(q, n, mod) + correction) % mod
